newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0437 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, with players awaiting a new lowering in the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band, between 1.0435 and 1.0485 per dollar, was fixed by the Central Bank on Friday.
Players had expected the Central Bank to lower the mini-band today, but now they think the bank might move the mini-band on Tuesday, or at late on Wednesday.
So far this month, the mini-band has been lowered 0.43 percent. Over the last few months, the Central Bank has lowered the mini-band between 0.50 percent and 0.65 percent.
Players are betting on a total decline in the mini-band during January between 0.55 percent and 0.65 percent.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed at 1.0493 per dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.9 percent to end at 1.100 per greenback.
